title.narrative: Trust Fund to Support the Kosovo energy efficiency fund (KEEF)

description.narrative: The purpose of the administration agreement is to support to the Kosovo energy efficiency fund (KEEF) which is established by the Law on energy efficiency. the IPA grant will cover operating expenditures of the Fund for 4 years, will provide technical assistance for preparation and superivison of the energy efficiency projects in public buildings and will support the capital investments of the Fund on energy efficiency measures.
